# funkalization

> Visual semantic design workspace — a text-and-visual means of proposing,
> revising, and inspecting software designs while preserving semantic meaning,
> authority, and evidence. Versioned design workspace with typed design edits,
> generated obligations, scoped evidence, deterministic read-only projections,
> and loss-reporting adapters toward Specodelic and OpenSpec.

- **Binary:** `funkalization`
- **Crate:** `funkalization` (crates.io, once first release is tagged)
- **Repo:** https://github.com/charly-vibes/funkalization
- **Book:** https://charly-vibes.github.io/funkalization/
- **Category:** extension (charly-vibes ecosystem, managed by ddl)
- **Maturity:** experimental
- **Design contract:** `openspec/design/visual-semantic-design-implementation-2026-10-13/` (VSD-IMPLEMENTATION-2026-10-13) — gates G0–G8, falsifiable claims C01–C08
- **Specs:** all spec material lives under `openspec/` in the repo (no duplicates elsewhere)
- **CI gate:** `just ci` (cargo fmt --check + clippy -D warnings + tests)
- **Config dir (planned):** `.funkalization/` in the target repo
- **Ecosystem map:** https://charly-vibes.github.io/dulce-de-leche/ecosystem-map.html
